brief: Aerial attacks build up mounting x1.25 faster, and the struggle gauge fills x1.25 faster while you are mounted. All mount build-up boosts combined are capped at x1.4.
Aerial attacks build up mounting at only x0.9, and the struggle gauge fills at x0.9 while you are mounted. Not applied while Mounting Master or Snowbaron Soul X is active.
Jumping attacks and other aerial attacks deal x1.1 physical damage (elemental damage is not raised) and build up mounting x1.1 faster.
Every fill of the Hunter Arts gauges, the Alchemy gauge and the Valor gauge is x1.15, so each gauge fills about 13% sooner.
Health lost to some hits (counted up to 150) is added to your Hunter Arts gauges (x1.4 in Striker), and to the Valor gauge in Valor style or doubled to the Alchemy gauge in Alchemy style.
The SP state from every SP Hunter Art lasts 25% longer (x1.25).
No Paintball is needed: large monsters are shown on the Map at all times. While it is active, Detect is skipped and Autotracker's display is used.
Marked large monsters show more on the Map, with a stronger version for the first 30 seconds of a quest, then a 2 in 3 chance of another 30-second window every 5 minutes.
Shows on the Map when a large monster can be captured, so you don't need to guess or watch for limping before setting a trap. It activates at +10 Perception points.
The Map is always shown even without the Map item, the BBQ Spit's done window grows from about 0.67 to 1 second, and fishing with Sushifish, Burst or Goldenfish Bait works as with Felyne Fisher.
Each hit that damages you has a 25% (1 in 4) chance to deal only x0.7 damage. With Felyne Defender (Hi) as well, the chance rises to 43.75%.
Each hit that damages you has a 25% (1 in 4) chance to deal x1.3 damage, about 7.5% more damage taken on average. It never triggers while Divine Blessing is active.
Any hit that would deal 5 damage or less after your defence does 0 instead. It is checked after Divine Blessing, so a hit that skill cuts to 5 or less is negated too.
Every Health recovery is x1.25 (rounded down): a Potion heals 37 instead of 30, a Mega Potion 62 instead of 50. Also raises healing attacks and the Charge Blade's phial heal.
Every Health recovery is x0.75: a Potion heals 23 instead of 30, a Mega Potion 38 instead of 50. Not applied while Recovery Up or Benediction is active.
Red Health comes back four times as fast: one tick every 0.5 seconds instead of every 2. A tick is normally 1 Health, 2 while an item's regeneration effect such as Immunizer is running.
Red Health comes back twice as fast: one tick every second instead of every 2 seconds. A tick never heals past the red part.
Red Health comes back at half speed: one tick every 4 seconds instead of every 2.
Red Health comes back at a quarter of the speed: one tick every 8 seconds instead of every 2.
Timed effects from items you use last 50% longer (x1.5): Might Seed and Dash Juice 4.5 min instead of 3, Cool and Hot Drinks 15 min instead of 10.
Timed effects from items you use last only x0.66 as long: Cool and Hot Drinks 6 min 36 s instead of 10 min. Not applied while Item Use Up or Elementality is active.
Potions, Herbs, Might Seeds, Adamant Seeds, Antidotes, Nulberries and some other items also affect nearby hunters at full strength. The receiver's own healing skills apply.
Certain items also affect nearby hunters: heals and stat boosts at half strength (a Potion heals 15, a Might Seed gives Attack +5), cures and Nulberry effects in full.
Your maximum Stamina no longer drops by 25 every 6 minutes. In a cold area without protection it still drops at the cold rate.
Your maximum Stamina drops by 25 every 12 minutes instead of every 6. The extra drain in a cold area without protection is not halved.
Your maximum Stamina drops by 25 every 4 minutes instead of every 6 (x1.5). The extra drain in a cold area without protection is unchanged.
Your maximum Stamina drops by 25 every 3 minutes instead of every 6. The extra drain in a cold area without protection is unchanged.
Many consumables, such as Potions, Herbs, Seeds and fish, get a 1 in 3 chance to raise your maximum Stamina by 25. It also counts as Gourmand; maximum Stamina never goes above 150.
Food that raises maximum Stamina, such as meats, adds 25 more on top of its normal amount. Maximum Stamina never goes above 150.
Using items plays x1.7 faster (about 59% of the normal time) and eating meat x1.8 faster, saving about 1 second per steak.
Eating meat plays x1.8 faster, saving about 1 second. Other items are not sped up.
Eating meat takes about 0.67 seconds longer, as the chewing part repeats up to 4 more times. Not applied while Speed Eating is active.
Each item you eat or drink has a 25% chance not to be used up, with a message when it is saved. Does not work on Glutton Tuna, Gastronome Tuna, the four oils or Cleanser.
Raw Meat becomes usable, and Rare Steak, Well-done Steak, Chilled Meat and Hot Meat stop Stamina from draining for 60 seconds. Mosswine Jerky raises maximum Stamina by 25.
Lets you eat mushrooms, each giving an item's effect: Blue Mushroom heals 30 and cures, Nitroshroom acts as Demondrug, Mopeshroom as Dash Juice, Super Mushroom heals 50.
A Herb heals 50 instead of 20, and a Herb shared to you through Wide-Range heals x2.5. Herbology is ignored while it is active.
A Herb heals 30 instead of 20, and a Herb shared to you through Wide-Range heals x1.5. Not used while Pro Herbology is active.
Adds 45 points to the success rate of combinations, so any recipe at 55% or more always succeeds. Stacks with Felyne Combiner and the Combo Books, capped at 100%.
Adds 20 points to the success rate of combinations: a 65% recipe becomes 85%. Stacks with Felyne Combiner and the Combo Books, capped at 100%.
Takes 10 points off the success rate of combinations: a 65% recipe becomes 55%. Combinations another skill guarantees, such as with Trap Master or Bombardier, are unaffected.
Takes 20 points off the success rate of combinations: a 65% recipe becomes 45%. Combinations another skill guarantees, such as with Trap Master or Bombardier, are unaffected.
Combinations that can produce more than one item always give the maximum number instead of a random amount. It does not change the chance of success.
Combinations for Poisoned Meat, Tinged Meat, Drugged Meat, Net, Pitfall Trap and Shock Trap always succeed, and setting traps and bombs plays at double speed.
Gathering Points last longer: after the guaranteed gathers, each further gather has a 3 in 32 chance to empty the point instead of 7 in 32. Felyne Gatherer lowers it further.
Gathering Points last longer: after the guaranteed gathers, each further gather has a 5 in 32 chance to empty the point instead of 7 in 32. Felyne Gatherer lowers it further.
Gathering Points run out sooner: after the guaranteed gathers, each further gather has an 11 in 32 chance to empty the point instead of 7 in 32. Does nothing while Pack Rat is active.
Every time you gather Honey or Royal Honey you get one extra. It is not a chance: it always happens.
Mining a Mystery, Shining, Timeworn or Enduring Charm has a 30% chance to give a second charm.
Mining a Mystery, Shining, Timeworn or Enduring Charm has a 20% chance to give a second charm. Charm Chaser (+15 Charmer points) raises it to 30%.
Whenever a Pickaxe, Bug Net, Flute or Boomerang would break, it is saved half the time, halving the break chance (an Iron Pickaxe goes from 10% to 5%).
A Pickaxe or Bug Net that would break is saved 1 time in 4 (break chance x3/4), and a Flute or Boomerang 1 time in 3 (x2/3).
On 1 use in 4, a tool's break odds are roughly doubled, so an Iron Pickaxe breaks 11.7% of the time instead of 10%.
On half of all uses, a tool's break odds are roughly doubled, so an Iron Pickaxe breaks 13.3% of the time instead of 10%.
Each roll for an extra quest reward succeeds 31 times in 32 instead of 22 in 32, so going from 3 to 8 rewards happens 85% of the time instead of 15%.
Each roll for an extra quest reward succeeds 28 times in 32 instead of 22 in 32, so going from 3 to 8 rewards happens 51% of the time instead of 15%.
Each roll for an extra quest reward succeeds 25 times in 32 instead of 22 in 32, so going from 3 to 8 rewards happens 29% of the time instead of 15%.
Each roll for an extra quest reward succeeds only 16 times in 32 (50%) instead of 22 in 32. Does nothing while Bounty Hunter is active.
Each roll for an extra quest reward succeeds only 8 times in 32 (25%) instead of 22 in 32. Does nothing while Bounty Hunter is active.
You always get one extra carve on monsters, and attacks can't knock you back while you carve. Felyne Carver adds nothing on top.
Attacks can't knock you back while you carve, so a carve is not interrupted. It activates at +10 Carving points; +15 gives Carving Celebrity, which also adds an extra carve.
Each captured monster gives one more capture reward: 4 rewards 68.75% of the time, otherwise 3 (3.69 on average instead of 2.69).
Each captured monster always gives 3 capture rewards, removing the 2-reward result that happens 5 times in 16 without the skill.
Gives Fire Res +15 and Halve Hunger together: fire resistance +15, and your maximum Stamina drains at half speed over time. With Fire Res +20 you get +20 instead, not both.
Gives Spirit's Whim and Thunder Res +15: a Pickaxe or Bug Net that would break is saved 1 time in 4, a Flute or Boomerang 1 in 3, and thunder resistance is +15. Works with Divine Whim.
Gives Ice Res +15 and Gourmand: ice resistance +15, and meats that raise your maximum Stamina give +25 more.
Gives Honey Hunter and Water Res +15: one extra Honey or Royal Honey every time you gather one, and water resistance +15.
Gives Bio Researcher and Dragon Res +15: prevents Stench and Blastblight, Dung Bomb Combinations always succeed, dung-type effects are stronger, and dragon resistance is +15.
Gives Knockout King (the stun value of your hits is x1.1) and Horn Maestro (a Flute or horn item that would break is saved half the time, and Hunting Horn songs last longer).
Counts as Focus and Resentment: some weapons' gauges fill x1.2 and charge levels come x1.25 faster, and you get +20 attack while there is red health on your gauge.
Counts as Evade Extender and Stam Recov Up: evades travel further with every weapon, and Stamina regenerates x2.
Counts as Razor Sharp, Recoil Down +2 and Divine Blessing: sharpness loss halved, Bowgun recoil 2 grades lower, and a 25% chance that a hit's damage is cut to x0.7.
Counts as Adrenaline +2 and Scavenger: at 40% health or less, attack x1.3 and defense +45; many consumables get a 1 in 3 chance of +25 max Stamina, and meat gives +25 more.
Counts as Status Atk +2 and Wide-Range +2: poison, paralysis and sleep build-up x1.2 then +1 (not blast), and items such as Potions and Seeds are shared with nearby hunters at full strength.
Counts as Charm Chaser and Negate Hunger: a 30% chance of a second charm when you get a Mystery, Shining, Timeworn or Enduring Charm, and max Stamina no longer drops by 25 every 6 minutes.
Counts as Evasion +2 and Critical Eye +3: longer invulnerability on evades (a standard roll goes from 0.2 s to 0.4 s) and +30% affinity.
Counts as Negate Stun and Challenger +2: you are never stunned, and once a large monster in your area has been enraged for 3 s you get +20 attack and +15% affinity.
Counts as Attack Up (L) and Windproof (Hi): +20 attack added before every multiplier, and small and large wind pressure is removed.
Counts as Latent Power +2 (once triggered: +50% affinity and Stamina costs x0.25 for 2.5 minutes) and Constitution +2 (evades and guards cost x0.5 Stamina).
Counts as HG Earplugs and Speed Eating +2: blocks both large and small roars, items are used x1.7 faster and meat is eaten x1.8 faster.
Counts as Sharpness +2 (up to +50 maximum sharpness), Shot Booster (one power stage lasts longer in flight; not Pellet, Crag or Cluster S) and Speed Sharpening (a whetstone takes one stroke).
Counts as HG Earplugs, Reload Speed +3 and Steady Hand: blocks large and small roars, Bowguns reload 3 grades faster, hits that would bounce land instead, and sharpness loss is halved.
Counts as Guard +2 and Quick Sheath: the guard power of every blocked attack is cut by 20 (smaller reactions, less Stamina), and sheathing is x1.4 faster with every weapon.
Counts as Critical Eye +3 and Challenger +1: +30% affinity, plus +10 attack and +10% affinity once a large monster in your area has been enraged for 3 s.
Counts as Critical Boost, Bonus Shot and Sharpness +1: critical hits deal x1.4 instead of x1.25, Light Bowgun rapid fire fires one more shot, and +1 sharpness level.
Counts as Marathon Runner, Bludgeoner and Normal/Rapid Up: sprinting drains Stamina x0.5, blademaster attack x1.1 to x1.2 at green or lower sharpness, and Normal S and Rapid arrows deal x1.1.
Counts as Attack Up (L) and Evasion +2: +20 attack added before every multiplier, and longer invulnerability on evades (a standard roll goes from 0.2 s to 0.4 s).
Counts as Resentment, Focus and Marathon Runner: +20 attack while you have red health, some weapons' gauges fill x1.2 and charge levels come x1.25 faster, and sprinting drains Stamina x0.5.
Counts as Evade Extender, Mounting Master and Stam Recov Up: evades travel further, mount build-up from aerial hits is x1.25, and Stamina regenerates x2.
Counts as Razor Sharp, Recoil Down +2, Divine Blessing and Constitution +1: sharpness loss halved, recoil 2 grades lower, 25% chance a hit is cut to x0.7, evades cost x0.75 Stamina.
Counts as Adrenaline +2, Scavenger and Artillery Expert: attack x1.3 at 40% health or less, many consumables may raise max Stamina, Gunlance shells x1.2 and Charge Blade phial bursts x1.35.
Counts as Status Atk +2, Wide-Range +2 and Pro Herbology: poison, paralysis and sleep build-up x1.2 then +1, items shared with nearby hunters at full strength, and a Herb heals 50.
Counts as Charm Chaser, Hero's Talisman and Negate Hunger: a 30% chance of a second charm, hits of 5 damage or less deal 0, and max Stamina no longer drops by 25 every 6 minutes.
Counts as Evasion +2, Critical Eye +3 and Sneak: longer invulnerability on evades, +30% affinity, and monsters favour you less as a target (x0.8). It also cancels Taunt.
Counts as Negate Stun, Challenger +2 and Fortify: never stunned, +20 attack and +15% affinity after a large monster is enraged for 3 s, and attack x1.1/x1.2 after one/two faints.
Counts as Windproof (Hi), Attack Up (L) and Adrenaline +1: small and large wind pressure removed, +20 attack, and defense +45 instead of +30 at 40% health or less.
Counts as Latent Power +2, Constitution +2 and Focus: +50% affinity and x0.25 Stamina costs for 2.5 minutes once triggered, evades cost x0.5 Stamina, and gauges and charges build faster.
Counts as Speed Eating +2, HG Earplugs and Longer SP: items used x1.7 faster and meat x1.8, both large and small roars blocked, and the SP state lasts x1.25 as long.
